title: Kigali Drift King
desc: Endless drift racer set in Kigalis hills. Hold left/right to steer, drift through curves for combo multipliers. Avoid road edges! Features: procedural neon cars, day/night cycle, particle effects, procedural audio. Controls: Arrow keys or tap left/right halves of screen. High-score chasing with smooth 60fps game play.
tips: Read the next obstacle early before making a move.
Use small, steady inputs instead of overcorrecting.
Restart quickly and learn the pattern one attempt at a time.
